name: phct
description: Pub Health Catalog Template (PHCT) — configurable GitHub-Pages catalog/CMS for public-health and civic teams: AI use case catalog, cohort portal, resource library, or your own schema. Live examples of every preset.

paragraphs: A configurable, GitHub-Pages-hosted catalog and resource site, managed entirely through GitHub. There is no server, no database and no CMS login — Jekyll builds the site on GitHub Actions and deploys it to Pages, and every content change flows through a GitHub issue and a pull request.

Live demo: crypticpy.github.io/phct — a landing page introducing the template, with four complete sites built from this same repository behind it. Each is a real build with its own fields, filters, colours and sample content, search and submission form included:
features: AI use case catalog — the configuration this repository ships with.
Cohort portal — a training program's teams, cohort by cohort, with the events and cohorts modules on.
Resource library — shorter entries and more of them: guides, toolkits and datasets.
Blank catalog — the smallest useful starting point, ready to be renamed.

GitHub-as-CMS. Anyone can propose an entry through a web form or a GitHub issue. Automation turns the issue into a pull request with the entry already drafted — screenshots downloaded into the entry folder and all — and…
